name: speak-flow
description: SpeakFlow - local and cloud speech-to-text for Windows
author: Khent Felary G Sanco <khentplaysmoba@gmail.com>

scripts.check: pnpm check:whitespace && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle
scripts.check:formal: python scripts/test_check_formal.py && python scripts/test_async_ownership_traces.py && python scripts/test_async_output_wiring.py && python scripts/check_formal.py --inventory-only
scripts.check:python: uv run --no-sync python -m compileall -q scripts src-tauri/resources && uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s src-tauri/resources -p "test_*.py" && uv run --no-sync python scripts/test_build_engine_atomicity.py && uv run --no-sync python scripts/test_release_ci.py && uv run --no-sync python scripts/test_generate_update_manifest.py && uv run --no-sync python scripts/test_ci_fail_fast.py
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: pnpm check:formal && pnpm check:python && pnpm check && pnpm check:rust
